message: Hi! I sent you Rs 4,999 by mistake on UPI. Please send it back to my number 98XXX XXXXX urgently.
why: This is the classic UPI mix-up trick. The money never came to you — if you send, your own money goes.
tip: Check your own bank balance first. Never return money to a stranger's number.

message: Dear customer, your bank KYC has expired. Your account will be BLOCKED in 24 hours. Update now at http://bit.ly/kyc-fix.
why: Banks never warn you with a short link and a 24-hour threat. The link steals your details.
tip: Do not click. Visit your bank branch or call the number on your passbook.

message: Grandma, it's me! I lost my phone and I am at the police station. Please send Rs 10,000 now, and don't tell mummy and papa.
why: Scammers pretend to be a grandchild in trouble and beg you to keep it secret so you don't check.
tip: Hang up and call your grandchild on their real number before doing anything.

message: Your parcel is stuck at customs. Pay Rs 49 delivery fee here: http://tinyurl.com/deliver-now to release it.
why: Real courier companies don't ask for small fees through short links in SMS.
tip: If you did not order anything, ignore it. If you did, track it on the company's own app.

message: Congratulations! You won Rs 25,00,000 in the KBC lottery. Pay Rs 5,000 registration fee to claim your prize.
why: You cannot win a lottery you never entered. Real prizes never ask you to pay first.
tip: Delete it. Never pay any fee to receive a prize.

message: Your SBI account ending 4821 is credited with Rs 2,000 pension for November. HDFC Bank will never call to ask for OTP.
why: This only informs you about money received. It asks for nothing and even reminds you to protect your OTP.
tip: Safe to keep. Still, open your bank app yourself to confirm the balance.

message: Electricity will be CUT tonight due to unpaid bill. Pay immediately at http://t.co/power-bill to avoid disconnection.
why: Electricity boards send proper bills with your consumer number, not panic links the same night.
tip: Check your bill on the official electricity app or pay at the counter.

message: Work from home! Earn Rs 5,000 per day liking videos. Just pay Rs 999 training fee first to join.
why: Real jobs pay you — they never ask you to pay a joining or training fee.
tip: Never pay for a job offer that arrived by SMS or WhatsApp.

message: Never share your OTP with anyone. Bank staff will never call and ask for your OTP or PIN. Stay safe.
why: This message protects you. It asks for nothing and warns you to keep secrets secret.
tip: Safe to keep. Remember it whenever anyone calls asking for codes.

message: This is bank customer care. To process your refund, please install AnyDesk and share your screen so we can help.
why: No real bank asks to see your phone screen. Screen sharing lets them steal OTPs and empty your account.
tip: Never install apps or share your screen because a caller told you to.
